gen-dafont-true-north-gf-almendra: Contemporary and stocky, True North lets its curves stay stubbornly open while Almendra sits beside it with a deep, bookish lowercase. One shouts in the present tense, the other murmurs with dignity.
gen-dafont-true-north-gf-bree-serif: Literary at heart, Bree Serif brings outsized lowercase proportions to the text, while True North stays stocky with curves left open. True North grabs attention; Bree Serif keeps the sentences moving.
gen-dafont-true-north-gf-port-lligat-sla: A massive middle band makes True North look stocky, while Port Lligat Slab sets wide, porthole-like counters into its lowercase. Longer reading should feel literary and traditional, with room to breathe.
gen-dafont-true-north-gf-quando: Stocky lines with curves that refuse to close mark True North. Quando, bookish and sparsely spaced, deserves a slightly larger size so its wide letter spacing has room to work.
gen-dafont-visitor-gf-quando: Gaping mouths on every e give Visitor a nostalgic, solder-drawn look, with short ascenders over big bowls. Quando settles into a slow, bookish pace across paragraphs, its spacing sparse and wide.
gen-dafont-woodgod-fs-amulya: Woodgod's lowercase nearly climbs to the capitals' full height. Against that, Amulya's moderate lowercase and generous curve gaps make height itself the pair's defining contrast, vintage command against modern ease.
gen-dafont-woodgod-fs-plein: Vintage muscle up front, with Woodgod's lowercase nearly reaching the capitals. Woodgod is best at commanding attention, while Plein, clean and reliable, is best at carrying the words quietly.
gen-dafont-woodgod-gf-quando: Sparse and bookish, the body text moves slowly beneath Woodgod's commanding, vintage lettering. Quando's wide spacing against Woodgod's lowercase, nearly as high as its capitals, is what makes the pair memorable.
gen-dafont-woodgod-plus-jakarta-sans: Vintage weight, modern finish: Woodgod's lowercase nearly reaches its capitals while Plus Jakarta Sans keeps its monoline curves well apart. Shrink Woodgod, or enlarge Plus Jakarta Sans, and the height gap fades.
gen-eater-fs-amulya: Eater draws dark, aggressive strokes that taper like a sharpened pencil line, with short ascenders and wide gaps. Amulya's generous curve gaps keep extended reading light and contemporary after all that bite.
